name: Ricardo Alves
bio:
Ricardo developed a keen eye for detail early, helping his grandfather restore classic cars in São Paulo. This passion led him to a technical college where he excelled in automotive refinishing, quickly becoming known for his flawless paintwork and meticulous approach. He joined Rahal Letterman Lanigan after several years working for smaller racing teams in Brazil, eager to apply his skills on a larger stage.

Ricardo's pragmatic approach ensures that the team's cars not only look stunning but also meet the highest standards of aerodynamic efficiency. He's a stickler for preparation, believing that a perfect finish starts with a perfectly prepped surface. He is always willing to share his knowledge and mentor junior team members, making him a valuable asset to the team's collaborative environment.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave.
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a lean build, and a focused expression.

quirks: Insists on using a specific brand of Brazilian carnauba wax.
Always listens to classic samba music while working.
Meticulously cleans his spray guns after every use, even for minor touch-ups.
